Move faster from brief to live pages

Prismic is the Agentic Web Platform built on the flexibility of a Headless CMS. Your marketing team and AI agents turn strategy into on-brand landing pages and websites at scale while developers stay in control.

Get a demo

No credit card required

Built for your brand. Designed for growth

Your brand lives in Prismic. From guidelines and reusable sections to tone of voice and structured content, everything your team and AI agents need is in one place. Build SEO pages that rank, campaign pages that convert, and websites that stay consistently on brand. Connect your existing tools through our MCP to enrich every experience and automate the work that slows your team down.

4,800+

marketers using Prismic

23x

recognized for excellence on G2

Your team and AI agents, working together in one platform

Landing pages for ABM

Convert more accounts with pages built for every company. Your brand context, your commands. AI agents generate at scale while your team stays in control.

Landing pages for SEO/GEO

Get found in AI search and Google. With built-in schema support, every page is ready to appear in AI-powered discovery engines, Google AI Overviews, and Google Search.

Headless CMS page builder

A headless CMS page builder lets you assemble pages from reusable components while developers control the code. Developers build reusable, brand-approved sections once. Your team takes it from there.

AI translation

Create and manage multilingual content without copy-pasting between tools. Each locale stays aligned with your master page structure while giving local teams room to customize messaging for their audience.

One prompt. All your pages, updated

No tabs. No copy-pasting. You stay in one place, and your pages keep up. Prismic connects directly to ChatGPT and Claude. Ask them to make changes across your pages. Update a CTA on every page, batch translate, rewrite a section, all with a prompt. It finds the right pages, makes the edits, and queues them for your review.

How your team can launch pages in minutes, not weeks

1

Create reusable, brand-approved page sections once and they will become the foundation for every future page.

Choose how to build your library:
- DIY: your team builds and maintains it
- Done-for-you: Prismic handles the initial setup for you
- Agency: one of our partners helps you with the setup
